drug_profiles.name: Tamoxifen
drug_profiles.mechanism: Selective oestrogen-receptor modulator with antagonist activity in breast tissue and tissue-dependent partial agonism elsewhere. Tamoxifen and active metabolites compete at ER. CYP3A4 mainly forms N-desmethyltamoxifen, which CYP2D6 converts to endoxifen; avoid empiric dose escalation for interactions. Tissue-specific action explains uterine stimulation and differing pre/postmenopausal bone effects.

drug_profiles.name: Fulvestrant
drug_profiles.mechanism: Selective ER degrader: competitive ER antagonism with affinity comparable to oestradiol, reduced ER protein and ER-driven transcription, without the partial agonist activity characteristic of tamoxifen. IM depot provides prolonged absorption; the additional Day 15 dose increases exposure during initiation.

drug_profiles.name: Anastrozole
drug_profiles.mechanism: Nonsteroidal, reversible aromatase inhibitor; reduces peripheral conversion of androgens to oestrogens. It is not an ovarian-suppression drug or an ER degrader.

drug_profiles.name: Letrozole
drug_profiles.mechanism: Nonsteroidal, reversible aromatase inhibitor; oestrogen deprivation rather than ER antagonism or ovarian suppression.

drug_profiles.name: Exemestane
drug_profiles.mechanism: Steroidal, irreversible aromatase inactivator. It mimics an androgen substrate and inactivates the enzyme; it does not degrade the oestrogen receptor. This mechanism does not establish superiority or interchangeable sequencing with nonsteroidal AIs.

drug_profiles.name: Capivasertib
drug_profiles.mechanism: Blocks AKT1, AKT2 and AKT3, proteins that help carry growth and survival signals inside cells. PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN alterations can activate this pathway. AKT also helps the body respond to insulin. Blocking it can raise blood sugar, which is why glucose checks start early.

drug_profiles.name: Vinorelbine
drug_profiles.mechanism: Vinorelbine disrupts the tiny structures a cell needs to divide. This can stop cancer cells multiplying. Healthy blood-forming cells, gut cells and nerves can also be affected.
